title.en: Upload Images: Presigned URLs and S3

outcome.ja: ブラウザが presigned URL で画像を S3 に直接送り、ノートに添付できる。
outcome.en: The browser sends an image straight to S3 with a presigned URL and attaches it to a note.

architecture.ja: SPA → API（presign）→ SPA → S3 PUT。閲覧は CloudFront + OAC 経由。
architecture.en: SPA → API (presign) → SPA → S3 PUT. Reads go through CloudFront + OAC.

Object key design and per-user separation
Lifecycle rules for incomplete uploads and orphaned objects
CORS

bucket の CDK（Block Public Access、lifecycle）と assertion

distributed.ja: S3 への書込みと DynamoDB の更新は一つの transaction ではない。孤立を許容して掃除する設計を示す。
distributed.en: The S3 write and the DynamoDB update are not one transaction; the design tolerates orphans and cleans them up.

title.ja: リクエストの外で処理する: SQS、DLQ、冪等性、Scheduler
title.en: Move Work off the Request: SQS, DLQs, Idempotency, and Scheduler

outcome.ja: 画像のサムネイル生成を queue に逃がし、同じメッセージが二度届いても結果が一つになる。
outcome.en: Thumbnail generation moves to a queue, and a message delivered twice still produces one result.

architecture.ja: S3 event → SQS → Lambda worker → S3 / DynamoDB。失敗は DLQ へ。Scheduler が定期掃除を起動。
architecture.en: S3 event → SQS → Lambda worker → S3 / DynamoDB. Failures go to a DLQ. Scheduler triggers periodic cleanup.

ja: at-least-once 配送と visibility timeout
partial batch response
idempotency key と conditional write
DLQ の監視と redrive
backpressure と同時実行数の上限
en: At-least-once delivery and the visibility timeout
Partial batch responses
Idempotency keys with conditional writes
Monitoring and redriving a DLQ
Backpressure and concurrency limits

ja: worker と idempotency store
重複配送・順序入替え・途中中断を注入する決定的テスト
queue / DLQ / event source mapping の CDK と assertion
en: Worker and idempotency store
Deterministic tests injecting duplicates, reordering, and mid-flight interruption
CDK for queue, DLQ, and event source mapping with assertions

distributed.ja: invariant は「1 つの画像に対しサムネイル記録は高々 1 つ」。SQS を使うこと自体は exactly-once を与えない。
distributed.en: Invariant: at most one thumbnail record per image. Using SQS does not by itself provide exactly-once processing.

title.ja: SSR と BFF: Nuxt をリージョンの Lambda で動かす
title.en: SSR and a BFF: Nuxt on Regional Lambda

outcome.ja: Nuxt アプリが東京リージョンの Lambda で HTML を返し、静的 asset は S3 から配信される。
outcome.en: A Nuxt app renders HTML on Lambda in the Tokyo region while static assets come from S3.

architecture.ja: CloudFront → (/_nuxt/* は S3) / (その他は Lambda の SSR)。これは edge rendering ではなく regional SSR。
architecture.en: CloudFront → (/_nuxt/* from S3) / (everything else to SSR on Lambda). This is regional SSR, not edge rendering.

ja: Nitro の AWS Lambda preset（固定版で確認）
cookie と個人別ページを共有 cache に載せない cache key 設計
response streaming の経路全体での確認
BFF として API を呼ぶときの認証の受け渡し
en: Nitro's AWS Lambda preset (verified at the pinned version)
Cache-key design that keeps cookies and personalized pages out of the shared cache
Verifying response streaming across the whole path
Passing authentication through a BFF

ja: Nuxt アプリと CDK
Cache-Control / cache policy を検証する assertion とローカル test
ログイン済みページが cache されないことの smoke test 手順
en: Nuxt app and CDK
Assertions and local tests for Cache-Control and cache policies
Smoke-test procedure showing signed-in pages are not cached

distributed.ja: CDN cache は古い内容を返し得る。誰の、どの期間の stale を許すかを明示する。
distributed.en: A CDN cache can serve stale content; state whose staleness is acceptable and for how long.

title.en: Understand the Edge: CloudFront Functions, KeyValueStore, and Lambda@Edge

outcome.en: The notes API runs as a container on ECS/Fargate and updates without downtime.

architecture.ja: ALB → ECS service（private subnet、2 task）。image は ECR。
architecture.en: ALB → ECS service (private subnets, two tasks). Images live in ECR.

ja: Docker CLI と host 側 daemon の区別
health check と rolling update、circuit breaker
task role と execution role
常時稼働の費用（Fargate、ALB、public IPv4）
auto scaling の指標
en: The Docker client versus the host daemon
Health checks, rolling updates, and the circuit breaker
Task role versus execution role
Always-on costs (Fargate, ALB, public IPv4)
Scaling metrics

ja: Dockerfile とアプリ
ECS/ALB の CDK と assertion
SIGTERM で進行中リクエストを完了させる graceful shutdown のテスト
en: Dockerfile and app
ECS/ALB CDK with assertions
A graceful-shutdown test that finishes in-flight requests on SIGTERM

distributed.ja: 更新中は新旧 version が同時に動く。両方が同じデータ形式を読めることを invariant にする。
distributed.en: Old and new versions run together during a deployment; both must read the same data format.

title.ja: D1 に親しんだ人の SQL 開発: Aurora DSQL、RDS PostgreSQL、Aurora Serverless v2
title.en: SQL Development for D1 Users: Aurora DSQL, RDS PostgreSQL, and Aurora Serverless v2

outcome.ja: schema、migration、型付き CRUD、seed/reset、テスト、実環境の migration、backup/restore までを SQL で一通り行える。
outcome.en: You run the whole SQL loop: schema, migrations, typed CRUD, seed/reset, tests, deployed migrations, and backup/restore.

architecture.ja: Lambda → Aurora DSQL（IAM 認証、VPC 不要の経路を一次情報で確認）。比較として RDS PostgreSQL / Aurora Serverless v2 は 11章の VPC 内。
architecture.en: Lambda → Aurora DSQL (IAM auth; verify the VPC-free path in current docs). For comparison, RDS PostgreSQL and Aurora Serverless v2 sit inside the chapter 11 VPC.

ja: 三つの選択肢を SQL 互換性・認証・接続・transaction・無通信時費用で選ぶ
DSQL は完全な PostgreSQL ではない: 対応 SQL/DDL と migration tool を固定版で確認
OCC による commit 時の競合と再試行
ローカルの PostgreSQL は代用であり DSQL の認証・競合を再現しない
Aurora auto-pause の条件と残る storage 料金
D1 の read replica/Sessions との保証範囲の比較
en: Choosing among three options by SQL compatibility, auth, connections, transactions, and idle cost
DSQL is not full PostgreSQL: verify supported SQL/DDL and migration tools at the pinned version
OCC conflicts at commit and retries
Local PostgreSQL is a substitute that reproduces neither DSQL auth nor contention
Aurora auto-pause conditions and the storage charges that remain
Comparing guarantee scope with D1 read replicas and Sessions

ja: migration、seed、reset の vp task（local / cloud を分離、cache: false）
型付き query 層と contract test
serialization failure を注入して再試行を確かめる決定的テスト
D1 側の比較コードを載せる場合は wrangler 設定を含む完全なソース
en: vp tasks for migrate, seed, and reset (local and cloud separated, cache: false)
Typed query layer with contract tests
Deterministic tests that inject serialization failures and verify retries
If D1 comparison code is shown, its complete source including wrangler configuration

distributed.ja: invariant は「transaction は全体が commit されるか全体が再試行される」。再試行は冪等な範囲に閉じる。
distributed.en: Invariant: a transaction either commits as a whole or is retried as a whole, and retries stay within idempotent scope.

title.ja: key-value と cache を選ぶ: DynamoDB、ElastiCache/Valkey、edge 設定
title.en: Choose a Key-Value Store or Cache: DynamoDB, ElastiCache/Valkey, and Edge Configuration

outcome.ja: rate limit と一覧の cache を題材に、三つの「KV」を目的・一貫性・寿命・料金で選び分ける。
outcome.en: Using a rate limiter and a list cache, you pick among three "KV" options by purpose, consistency, lifetime, and price.

architecture.ja: 同じ interface の裏に DynamoDB（TTL）と Valkey を置き、edge 設定は KVS に分ける。
architecture.en: DynamoDB (TTL) and Valkey behind one interface, with edge configuration kept in KVS.

ja: cache は消えてよいデータだけに使う
TTL の削除は即時ではない
Valkey は VPC と常時稼働費用を伴う（serverless の最小課金を確認）
cache stampede
en: Cache only data you can afford to lose
TTL deletion is not immediate
Valkey brings a VPC and standing cost (check the serverless minimum)
Cache stampedes

A test reproducing a stale read

distributed.ja: cache と元データの不一致を前提に、どちらが正かを決める。
distributed.en: Assume the cache and the source of truth disagree, and decide which one wins.

title.ja: メールを送る: SES
title.en: Send Email: SES

title.ja: 長い処理を動かす: ECS task、Step Functions、Lambda durable functions、AWS Batch
title.en: Run Longer Jobs: ECS Tasks, Step Functions, Lambda Durable Functions, and AWS Batch

outcome.ja: 全ノートの export を、途中で止まっても続きから再開できる処理として作る。
outcome.en: You build a full-notes export that resumes where it stopped after an interruption.

architecture.ja: Scheduler → workflow（Step Functions または durable function）→ 各 step の Lambda / ECS task → S3。
architecture.en: Scheduler → workflow (Step Functions or a durable function) → Lambda or ECS task per step → S3.

state transition 課金と待機の費用
en: Lambda's 15-minute limit and splitting work

ja: workflow 定義と step の実装

distributed.en: Steps can run again; make each one idempotent and choose the checkpoint granularity.

title.ja: 本番の挙動を見る: CloudWatch、OpenTelemetry、RUM、Synthetics
title.en: See Production Behavior: CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, RUM, and Synthetics

outcome.ja: 1 つのリクエストを browser から Lambda、queue の worker まで同じ ID で追える。
outcome.en: You follow one request from the browser through Lambda to the queue worker by a single ID.

architecture.ja: 構造化ログ → CloudWatch Logs。trace は OpenTelemetry → X-Ray。alarm → 通知。
architecture.en: Structured logs → CloudWatch Logs. Traces via OpenTelemetry → X-Ray. Alarms → notification.

ja: 04章のログ形式を土台にする
新規計装は OpenTelemetry。X-Ray SDK/daemon の寿命と X-Ray service は別
log の取込みと保存の費用
症状に対する alarm

OpenTelemetry for new instrumentation; the X-Ray SDK/daemon lifecycle is not the X-Ray service

alarm の CDK と assertion
log 量から費用を出す計算入力

Pricing inputs deriving cost from log volume

distributed.en: Traces are sampled; a missing span is not necessarily a failure.

title.en: Ship Changes: CI/CD, OIDC, Environments, Previews, Rollback, and Drift

outcome.ja: CI が OIDC の短命 credentials で同じ vp task を実行し、定期的な drift 検出が未検査も含めて報告する。
outcome.en: CI runs the same vp tasks with short-lived OIDC credentials, and scheduled drift detection reports uninspected scope too.

architecture.ja: pull request → check:all → infra:diff。main → deploy（標準の CDK/CloudFormation 経路）。schedule → drift。
architecture.en: Pull request → check:all → infra:diff. main → deploy (the standard CDK/CloudFormation path). Schedule → drift.

ja: 02章の drift gate を実環境へ
CloudFormation drift detection の検査範囲と nested stack
cdkd と CloudFormation を同じ resource に交互に使わない
rollback できるものとできないもの（data、schema）
preview 環境の費用と片付け
en: Taking the chapter 02 drift gate to a live account
CloudFormation drift-detection coverage and nested stacks
Never alternating cdkd and CloudFormation over the same resources
What rolls back and what does not (data, schema)
Preview-environment cost and cleanup

ja: OIDC role の CDK と trust policy の assertion
CI 設定（同じ Nix lock と vp task）
CloudFormation drift の polling/parser/report と fixture
drift 注入と解消の実環境ラボ手順

CI configuration (same Nix lock and vp tasks)
CloudFormation drift polling, parser, and report with fixtures
A live lab procedure for injecting and resolving drift

distributed.en: A deployment is not atomic; procedures assume a partially updated state after a mid-flight failure.

title.ja: 守り、統制する: WAF、Inspector、GuardDuty、secret、KMS、CloudTrail、Config、Organizations
title.en: Protect and Govern: WAF, Inspector, GuardDuty, Secrets, KMS, CloudTrail, Config, and Organizations

outcome.ja: 個人利用で入れるものと、組織になったら必要なものを分けて設定できる。
outcome.en: You configure what an individual needs and know what an organization adds.

architecture.ja: CloudFront + WAF。secret は Secrets Manager。監査は CloudTrail。脆弱性は Inspector、脅威は GuardDuty。
architecture.en: CloudFront + WAF. Secrets in Secrets Manager. Audit through CloudTrail. Vulnerabilities via Inspector, threats via GuardDuty.

ja: Inspector（脆弱性検査）と GuardDuty（脅威検出）は別物
WAF を付けられる入口と付けられない入口
secret ごと・key ごとの月額
SCP は権限を与えず上限を決める
en: Inspector (vulnerability scanning) and GuardDuty (threat detection) are different things
Which entry points can and cannot carry WAF
Per-secret and per-key monthly charges
SCPs set limits; they grant nothing

ja: WAF rule の CDK
secret を読む adapter と rotation の手順
IAM policy の wildcard を検出する assertion
en: WAF rule CDK
Secret-reading adapter and a rotation procedure
Assertions that detect wildcard IAM policies

distributed.ja: IAM の変更は結果整合。直後の拒否/許可を前提にしない。
distributed.en: IAM changes are eventually consistent; do not rely on an immediate allow or deny.

title.en: Recover Data and Service: PITR, Snapshots, S3 Versioning, and AWS Backup

outcome.ja: 誤って消したノートと画像を実際に復元し、かかった時間と失ったデータを記録する。
outcome.en: You actually restore accidentally deleted notes and images and record the time taken and data lost.

architecture.en: DynamoDB PITR → restore into a new table → cut over. S3 restores from versions.

ja: replication は backup ではない: 削除も複製される

backup の保存費用

Backup storage cost

A script checking the chapter 05 and 08 invariants after restore
A drill record template

distributed.ja: DB と object store は別時点に戻る。復元後の不整合を検出して直す。
distributed.en: The database and the object store restore to different points in time; detect and repair the mismatch.

outcome.en: You reach an EC2 instance without opening SSH, run a process as a service, and patch it.

architecture.ja: private subnet の instance + instance role + SSM Session Manager。data は別の EBS volume。
architecture.en: An instance in a private subnet with an instance role and SSM Session Manager; data on a separate EBS volume.

systemd と graceful shutdown

en: Instance roles and temporary credentials

systemd and graceful shutdown
What you own on a long-lived machine

ja: instance の CDK と user data
systemd unit
volume の snapshot/restore 手順
en: Instance CDK and user data
systemd unit
Volume snapshot and restore procedure

distributed.ja: 1 台は単一障害点。それを受け入れる条件を明示する。
distributed.en: One machine is a single point of failure; state when that is acceptable.

title.ja: 発展ラボ: celld を AWS でセルフホストする
title.en: Advanced Lab: Self-Hosting celld on AWS

outcome.ja: celld を 1 台の EC2 で動かし、次に小さな fleet で drain・更新・復旧を試す。
outcome.en: You run celld on one EC2 instance, then try draining, upgrading, and recovery on a small fleet.

architecture.ja: private subnet の node 群（peer 通信は private + TLS）+ 保持する EBS と S3 bucket。CDK はインフラまで、celld の配置は別手順。
architecture.en: Nodes in private subnets (private peer traffic over TLS) with retained EBS volumes and an S3 bucket. CDK stops at infrastructure; deploying celld is a separate procedure.

ja: celld は AWS の managed service ではなく、版を固定して自分で運用する OSS（調査時点で beta）
公式の limitations/security/guarantees/upgrade notes を再確認
S3 があっても全 node の disk を同時に捨てられるとは限らない
drain と更新の順序
未確認の cdkd 統合は作らない
en: celld is self-operated, version-pinned OSS (beta when researched), not an AWS managed service

No invented cdkd integration

配置・drain・更新・backup/restore の script と vp task
node 喪失後に object ownership の invariant を確かめる検査

distributed.en: Guarantees depend on celld's documented protocol and failure model; no claim of losslessness under arbitrary failures.
